source.snippet: Is anyone else experiencing delays in getting a CVE ID assigned on Github? I can only assume there's a flood of reports coming from researchers using LLMs. https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/199123

problem_statement: Security researchers and open-source maintainers are experiencing significant delays in CVE ID assignment through GitHub's advisory system, likely due to a surge of LLM-generated vulnerability reports flooding the queue. This blocks coordinated disclosure timelines and creates legal/reputational risk for maintainers and companies awaiting a CVE before patching.
target_segment: Security researchers, OSS maintainers, and corporate AppSec teams that rely on GitHub Advisory Database / GHSA for CVE assignment as part of their vulnerability disclosure workflow
notes: Business context: AppSec teams at companies have SLAs on disclosure timelines; delays create compliance and PR risk. Signal is single post with 4 upvotes but references a broader community discussion thread, suggesting wider frustration. Potential product: a CVE tracking and escalation workflow tool that monitors assignment status, sends alerts, and helps teams manage disclosure timelines across multiple pending CVEs.
